additional_deadline_cases.scope: receipt preflight and process snapshot consume deadline: no guest query; recoverable query timeout resets stable window

deadline_interpretation: All guest queries and listener checks consume one absolute 120-second readiness budget; admission is refused after expiration. Existing synchronous regular-file/process identity reads do not receive a remaining-time parameter; receipt read locks have their own 1-second bound and macOS host UUID calls a 5-second bound. No new unbounded subprocess or wait was introduced.
ownership_nonzero_semantics: Post-query receipt/backend/listener validation happens before parsing a host nonzero response. Host nonzero resets readiness; ownership errors and malformed successful response framing still raise.
